page.layout: One printed page: one column of running text; below it at the right, the catchword "Lacc."; running head at the top; page number at the top left. No marginal notes. Show-through at lower left and scan edge marks at right are not transcribed.

main_text.p: dissuasore se, arbitrium liberum de hac permissum urbe fuerat, nunc totum id ab se rejicere: respondisse enim legatis Lacedæmoniorum-, r[illegible, ~1 letter]eorum ad se nihil pertinere: cupere autem eos, qui nunc rerum Lacedæmone potissimum potiuntur, Achaicæ societatis & reipu-blicæ fieri participes, quorum desiderio si morem gesserimus, inquiebat, duo perquàm utilia nobis as[?]sequemur: nam tum eos nobis jungemus, qui semper Achæorum genti benevoli & fidi fuerunt, & deinceps ejus decreta probaturi & confirmaturi sunt, & pro accepto beneficio parem gratiam volentibus diis, nobis relaturi; tum cum veteribus exulibus, quorum ingratos atque impios animos experti sumus, sponte suâ urbe decessuris, & melioribus locum in ea daturis, in republicâ nihil habituri sumus commune. Verum obsistebat Diophanes, & qui cum eo faciebant, semper adversantes consiliis Lycortæ, & jam è vivis sublati Philopœmenis: monebantque Achæos, ne in gratiam paucorum urgerent & premerent etiam ipsi fortunam miserorum extorrium, qui contra jus & fas patriâ ejecti essent.

page.notes: The page is printed with a blot over the word after "Lacedæmoniorum" (reading "re" + obscured letter + "eorum"); the obscured letter is marked as illegible. Scan is weak at the left and right edges. Lower-left text is show-through from the reverse side and was omitted. "assequemur" is partly unclear in the scan (marked [?]). Printed long s and ff/ss forms were normalised to plain s. "extorrium" is copied as printed and may be an error for "extorrium" or "extorrium" variant; no correction made. Hyphen "reipu-blicæ" kept as printed line-end hyphen.
